title: Dataq Swarm — Architecture & Trust
seo_title: Dataq Swarm — Architecture & Trust | Dataq Software
meta_description: Architecture, security posture and compliance evidence for Dataq Swarm — Agentic AI Orchestration Platform from Dataq Software.

blocks.x: Dataq Swarm — Architecture & Trust delivered as an operating capability for the enterprise, not a slide deck — durable runtime, policy-checked actions, and telemetry your auditors can read without translation.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (health, throughput, cost and policy telemetry, roles, bidding, priority lanes, SLA routing, autonomy tiers routed to approvals); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (saga patterns, compensation, idempotency, per-team/role token and action chargeback); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

blocks.x: Every agent action is policy-checked and logged under immutable audit trails. Tool access is scoped per role with short-lived credentials; high-risk actions require approval workflows. Swarm's evidence pack maps to ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF expectations for agentic systems.

items: Under the hood this pattern runs on one rule: cost and quality telemetry land in the same view your owners read across the Architecture & Trust estate, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence.

What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: evidence is captured where the work happens, not reconstructed later in Data, Analytics & Lakehouse delivery, so your control owners can interrogate any number we publish.
The part that survives audit is the boring part: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline for the enterprise at scale, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.
